title: Home Care Recruiter
description:
Home Care Recruiter — High Volume | Remote (Philippines) OPA Home Care & Skilled Nursing | Full-Time | Remote



What this role is?



OPA Home Care & Skilled Nursing is a fast-growing private home care company in the Atlanta metro area. We operate on one standard: zero missed shifts. Recruiting is what makes that possible.



This is a production role. You will own Stages 1 and 2 of our hiring pipeline — from first contact to behavioral screen — and you will be measured on daily output, not activity.



If you are looking for a sourcing or resume-review role, this is not it. If you move fast, follow a process without being told twice, and are comfortable disqualifying candidates who do not meet the bar, keep reading.



What you will do?



Monitor inbound applications from ZipRecruiter and Indeed. Every applicant receives a response the same business day — 48 hours is the ceiling, not the target. Contact sequence is non-negotiable: digital message, phone call (two attempts), follow-up
. Every action logged in AxisCare. If it is not in the system, it did not happen.



When you reach a candidate, you are not screening — you are recruiting. Lead with who OPA is and why it is a good opportunity. Then confirm licensure (CNA, HHA, PCA, LPN, Med Tech, or RN), schedule availability, ability to start within 7 days, and willingness to go through our on-call integration period. Candidates who do not answer the phone, do not respond within 48 hours, or do not meet the basic requirements are disqualified. No second chances, no exceptions.



Candidates who pass your call are directed to complete a behavioral phone screen as their next step. You track completion and process outcomes. Advancing candidates receive a call from you within two hours and a credentialing
 the same day.

title: Facebook Ads Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring Media Buyers Who Can Think Strategically, Learn Fast, and Execute Cleanly



We’re looking for 1 full-time Media Buyer to join our remote team directly.



This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands — but we are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks blindly.



We’re looking for people who understand media buying at a strategic level, can think through campaign decisions, recognize patterns in performance, and know when to take action, when to hold, and when to escalate.



You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 1

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

Workload: 80 hours per 2-week period, agreed upon at hire



Team Structure:

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Be open to feedback and treat it as an opportunity to improve

Be responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Be able to document your work clearly and consistently

Know when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Be willing to learn our internal systems while also bringing your own media buying judgment to the role



As a Media Buyer, You Will Be Responsible For:

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

Launching and maintaining campaigns using predefined structures

Monitoring performance signals and campaign pacing daily

Making thoughtful changes only when the data and signals justify it

Understanding the reason behind campaign actions, not just completing tasks mechanically

Documenting actions, updates, and observations inside ClickUp

Making FTW the second word in your application headline, followed by your first name

Flagging account, campaign, or performance issues early

Escalating when something truly feels off, without overreacting to every small dip

Joining structured check-ins with the Lead Media Buyer when needed

Staying aligned with our internal systems, workflows, and campaign standards

Contributing useful observations when you notice patterns, risks, or opportunities in the accounts you manage



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, quality of execution, and your ability to think through the work strategically.



This role starts with a 30-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, responsiveness, and good decision-making, there will be room to discuss salary growth — especially if the campaigns you handle are performing well and you are adding real value to the team and our clients.



We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.



Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for people who can adapt, think clearly, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body:



Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your media buying experience.



To confirm availability, please close the recording by saying:

“I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

• Role: YouTube Thumbnail Artist.

• Long-term role for someone reliable and consistent.



## Requirements



• Experience creating YouTube thumbnails.



• Good understanding of clickable thumbnail design.



• Ability to use AI tools or design software to create strong thumbnail concepts.



• Ability to follow references and match an existing channel style.

title: Acquisitions Closer
description:
Role: Acquisitions Closer (Cold Caller) — Probate & Curative Title Leads 

Company: EZ Texas Properties LLC 

Type: Direct Hire · Part-Time · 100% Remote 

Schedule: 30 hrs/week — Mon–Fri, 6 hrs/day, 1pm-7pm Central Standard Time 

Pay: $6/hr + $250 commission per closed deal 

Apply to: 
 — subject line must read EZ-ACQ





About the Role

We're a real estate company that resolves messy ownership situations — probate, heirship, and tax-delinquent properties — so deals can close. Your job is to reach the right heirs and owners, build trust fast, and turn a cold lead into a signed agreement.



This is not an entry-level role. We want a seasoned closer who can carry a high-volume phone day, handle sensitive conversations with heirs and families, stay professional under pressure, and consistently hit metrics — someone humble and approachable, but driven to close.



What You'll Do

Make 30–75+ outbound calls a day and hold 20–50 real conversations

Build rapport quickly and guide leads to a signed agreement without being pushy

Read and interpret obituaries and family trees to identify and reach the right point of contact

Log activity and move leads through the pipeline in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

Hit daily and weekly call and conversion metrics



Requirements

1–2+ years of cold-calling experience in outbound sales or customer service

Real estate background required

Strong, personable communicator who connects with people and closes

Self-motivated, focused, goal-driven, and a sharp critical thinker

Proven track record of meeting metrics in a fast-paced environment

Noise-cancelling headset, reliable computer/laptop, and high-speed internet

Able to work Central Standard Time hours



Nice to Have

Probate, heirship, or curative-title experience · Tennessee / Texas county-records familiarity · GoHighLevel (GHL) · manual skip tracing · an Upwork account with reviews



Compensation

$6/hr for 30 hrs/week (~$720/mo base), plus $250 per closed deal. Close just 2 deals a month and you're at roughly $1,220/mo — and there's no cap, so strong closers earn well beyond that.



How to Apply

 
 with subject line EZ-ACQ (applications without it won't be reviewed). Include:



Resume

DISC result — take the free test at 
/free-disc-test/

A 1-minute video — tell us a story about your proudest accomplishment



Follow all three steps or your application won't be considered. If you're humble, sharp, reliable, and a true go-getter, this is for you.

title: EXPERIENCED PRODUCT RESEARCHER — HEALTH & BEAUTY DROPSHIPPING (FUNNELISH + META AD LIBRARY)
description:
EXPERIENCED PRODUCT RESEARCHER — HEALTH & BEAUTY DROPSHIPPING (FUNNELISH + META AD LIBRARY)



Please read the full post before applying. Experienced dropshipping researchers only.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-scaling health, beauty, and wellness dropshipping company. We run Meta ads and sell through advertorial funnels, and we need a product researcher who can consistently find winning products before they saturate.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who lives inside the Meta Ad Library, understands Funnelish advertorial funnels, and has real experience researching health and beauty products for dropshipping brands.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Find winning health and beauty products (creams, patches, oils, drops, supplements, and similar) using the Meta Ad Library and spy tools.

- Study competitors' Funnelish stores and advertorial funnels to understand what is working and why.

- Validate demand using active ads, reach, ad longevity, creative volume, and angles.

- Track competitors and winning ads across markets, and collect creative swipes.

- Organize your findings in Google Sheets with product links, competitor and funnel links, Meta Ad Library links, reach, angles, and a clear recommendation.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Real experience doing product research for dropshipping companies in the health and beauty niche.

- You know what Funnelish is and can tell when a competitor's store or funnel is built on it, including spotting the advertorial.

- A lot of hands-on experience with the Meta Ad Library. This is your main tool, not an afterthought.

- Strong with spy tools such as WinningHunter, Minea, AdSpy, PPSpy, PiPiAds, and similar.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets and organized in how you present findings.

- Full-time and available long-term.

- Good English and clear communication.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience researching for UK and EU markets.

- Creative swipe and angle research.

- Experience finding advertorial-style winners.



WHAT WE OFFER



- A long-term, full-time role in a scaling company.

- Negotiable salary based on your experience and proven results.

- A team where creative, media buying, and fulfillment are already handled, so you can focus on research.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word WINNER so we know you read the full post.



Then answer the questions below clearly. Specific examples and real proof matter far more than general statements.



1. How many years have you done product research for health and beauty dropshipping stores?

2. What do you know about Funnelish, and how do you tell if a competitor's store or funnel is built on it?

3. How much of your research is done in the Meta Ad Library? Walk us through how you use it to validate a winning product.

4. What spy tools do you use, and how do you spot a product that is scaling right now?

5. What health and beauty products have you found and researched before? Give one specific example (the product, and why it was a winner).

6. What is an advertorial, and why does it matter for a health and beauty funnel?

7. Are you available full-time and long-term? What are your working hours and timezone?

8. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

9. Please share your CV. Sample research sheets or other proof of past work are welcome but optional.

10. Are you comfortable completing a short test task before hiring?



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short test task before any offer. We review every application that follows these instructions.

title: Content Producer & Strategist (Video + Distribution)
description:
About Dragon Lab

Dragon Lab is an emerging media platform and movement founded by neurosurgeon, Zen Buddhist priest, and author Patrick Codd. Each week we publish one thoughtful, long-form essay exploring medicine, neuroscience, leadership, identity, Zen, and the healing power of presence. That essay serves as the foundation for videos, graphics, interviews, and multi-platform conversations.



We are looking for someone who cares about meaningful storytelling and wants to help build a lasting editorial brand, not simply chase viral trends.



Job Overview & Role Context

We are seeking a highly motivated Content Producer & Strategist who thinks like a producer, not just an editor. You will own the production quality and distribution ecosystem surrounding Dragon Lab. 



Each week, the founder creates one original long-form essay along with a short, behind-the-scenes reflection video (60–90 seconds). Your job is to transform this raw material into a coordinated week of polished content and manage its distribution across all major platforms.



You are not expected to invent the core concepts or write the essays. Your role is to package, produce, publish, distribute, and continuously optimize the content engine.



Platform Focus

• Primary Growth: TikTok & Instagram Reels (high engagement, community building)

• Secondary Reach: YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn (selective posting, matching a professional tone), and Substack.



Core Responsibilities

• Video Production & Editing: Review raw footage provided by the team; edit 4–6 high-quality short-form vertical videos per week using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. Add captions, tasteful motion graphics, music, and platform-specific pacing.

• Strategic Hook Extraction: Read each weekly essay to identify the strongest emotional or intellectual hooks. Craft engaging video openings while preserving Dragon Lab's authentic, authoritative voice.

• Visual Asset Creation: Design quote graphics, carousel posts, video thumbnails, and cover images using Canva.

• Daily Market Awareness: Active monitoring of TikTok and Instagram to find overlapping communities, trending formats, and relevant discussions.

• Daily Briefing: Send a quick daily update to the team with 3–5 posts/conversations we should respond to and 2–3 fresh content ideas.

• Logistics & Scheduling: Manage all upload pipelines, optimize metadata (titles, tags, descriptions), cross-link back to Dragon Lab, and schedule posts.

• Analytics & Iteration: Track performance data weekly. Review analytics to identify winning patterns, provide feedback on what is working, and prepare a concise weekly report with actionable recommendations.



Weekly Workflow (Envisioned)

• Input Received: 

- 1 long-form essay,

- 1 short reflection video (60–90 seconds),

- and supporting images when available.



• Output Delivered: 

- 4–6 short-form videos,

- custom quote graphics,

- carousel posts,

- platform-specific captions,

- scheduled deployment across all networks,

- and a weekly performance report.



Skills & Experience

• Proven experience editing vertical short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).

• Proficiency with CapCut, Canva, and professional software (Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve).

• Deep understanding of social media platform algorithms, hook structures, pacing, and viewer retention.

• Excellent English communication skills (written and visual).

• Highly organized, proactive, and dependable.



Bonus Points for:

• Experience with Riverside, Photoshop, or advanced motion graphics.

• Thoughtful integration of AI editing tools.

• A proven track record of growing creator accounts.



Future Growth

Over time, you will work closely with a Dragon Lab Fellow (a medical student), who will focus heavily on audience insights, deep editorial research, and new content ideas. This allows you to focus fully on maximizing production execution, distribution systems, and overall visual quality.



Application Process & Interview Steps

To apply, please submit your application directly through this job post. Please ensure you include a link to your portfolio or examples of your previous short-form video work and visual graphic designs.



Our selection process follows these stages:

1. Initial Screening & Review: We will review your background and portfolio to evaluate your video editing style and layout consistency.

2. Alignment Call: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a brief alignment call to discuss the role, expectations, and culture fit.

3. Paid Trial Project: The top 3 finalists will proceed to a paid trial project using an active Dragon Lab Substack essay and its companion reflection video. For this trial, you will be asked to deliver:

- One Instagram Reel

- One LinkedIn-native video

- One TikTok edit

- One quote graphic

- One carousel post

- A brief one-week distribution plan



We are evaluating editorial judgment, storytelling instincts, layout consistency, and your ability to preserve an authentic brand voice, not just technical software skills.



No Outside Communication: Any outreach attempt made outside of the official application channels will result in automatic disqualification. We respect professional boundaries and seek a specialist who follows established systems.

title: E-commerce Creative Strategist & Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a sharp Creative Strategist / Video Ad Scriptwriter to help us create high-performing Meta ads for e-commerce brands.



This role is not about making “nice looking” videos. We need someone who understands direct response advertising, customer psychology, hooks, angles, pain points, and how to create video concepts that can actually drive purchases.



We run multiple e-commerce brands and are currently scaling one specific brand. The brand is fairly new, but we have already found one winning creative that performed well. That creative is now starting to die out because of creative fatigue and audience fatigue, so we need fresh angles, new concepts, and new videos that can hit the same customer pain points in a different way.



A big part of this role is also being able to create and localize creatives for different markets. We sell a lot in Nordic markets such as Sweden, Norway and Denmark, so it is important that you can think beyond just English creatives. You do not need to be a native speaker in all of these languages, but you must be able to research the market, understand local angles, and create or adapt scripts/copy for different countries with the right tone and structure.



Your job will be to:



* Research the product, market, competitors, and customer avatar

* Find strong new creative angles

* Write hooks and scripts for short-form video ads

* Create video concepts and briefs for UGC-style ads

* Create or localize creatives for different markets/languages, especially Swedish, Norwegian and Danish

* Think like a performance marketer, not just a content creator

* Help us improve CTR, lower CPA, and increase purchases



We are looking for someone who can work from scratch. We will give you the product, website, brand information, and examples of past creatives, but we want to see how you think, research, and develop new ideas yourself.



To start, we will test you with 2 paid video concepts/scripts. If the creatives perform well, this can turn into much more work. We have multiple brands, and we are willing to pay significantly more for people who can consistently create winning creatives.



This is a great opportunity for someone who is hungry, smart, and wants to grow with a fast-moving e-commerce company.



Requirements:



* Experience with Meta/Facebook ads

* Strong understanding of direct response marketing

* Ability to write strong hooks and scripts

* Good understanding of customer pain points and buying psychology

* Ability to research and create angles for different countries/markets

* Ability to create or adapt creatives in multiple languages, especially for Nordic markets

* Experience with e-commerce, beauty, fashion, wellness, or women’s products is a plus

* Fluent English



When applying, please include:



1. Examples of video ads or scripts you have worked on

2. Your process for finding new creative angles

3. Your experience with creating creatives for different countries/languages

4. Your rate for 2 test video concepts/scripts

5. Why you think you would be a good fit for this role

title: Game Designer – Shape a New 2D Unity Indie Game (Part-Time + Revenue Share)
description:
I'm building a small 2D indie game in Unity, and I'm looking for a part-time game designer to own the design side of the project. This is a design-ownership role — you'll drive the design work itself, but there's no team to manage (it's just the two of us for now). I handle overall project direction, production decisions, scheduling, and final approvals. You own the design: gameplay systems, mechanics, levels, progression, player experience, and documentation.



ABOUT THE PROJECT — WHERE WE HONESTLY ARE



I'll be straight with you. I'm a solo founder, self-funding this out of my own salary, and we're at the very start. The concept isn't locked yet, and helping shape it is part of the role — you won't be handed a finished design doc to execute. What I can tell you about the direction:



• Small in scope, built to be realistically shippable by a tiny team

• 2D, made in Unity, designed around tight, satisfying core mechanics rather than sprawling content

• Remote, part-time, and collaborative — though I keep final say on direction



I'd love to work with someone who gets small, tightly-designed 2D games and wants to help shape this one, not just build to spec.



THE ROLE, HONESTLY



• $650/month to start, for 20 hrs/week — with room to discuss based on experience and portfolio

• Revenue share: 10% of the game's revenue for 2 years after launch, on top of your monthly pay

• A named Game Designer credit on the released title

• Real creative ownership — you help define the game, not just document it

• Room to grow into a larger role, and a bigger stake, as the project hits its demo milestone and gains 
ntum



I'll be upfront about the revenue share: most indie games earn modestly, so treat it as genuine upside and shared alignment, not a guaranteed payout. It's tied to the game actually launching, and the full terms live in a simple written agreement so we're both clear from day one.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Define and refine the core gameplay loop

• Create and maintain the game design document (GDD)

• Design mechanics, levels, progression, and player flow

• Turn design ideas into clear specs for Unity developers

• Review playable builds and give structured design feedback

• Help guide UI/UX and 2D visual direction from a gameplay perspective

• Work with me to prioritize design tasks and milestones



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



• Experience designing at least one playable 2D game, prototype, or shipped project

• A portfolio showing game design work, not only artwork

• A strong sense of game feel, pacing, progression, and player experience

• Ability to write clear GDDs, feature specs, and feedback notes

• Familiarity with Unity workflows (you don't need to be a Unity programmer)

• Clear communication and the ability to work independently



HOW WE'LL WORK



I work on this part-time too, so we'll run semi-async. Every review and decision routes through me, and I'll aim to turn those around within a day or two so you're never left blocked. Honest expectations on both sides matter to me more than raw speed.



FIRST 30 DAYS



• Review the references and direction, and help shape the initial concept

• Define the core gameplay loop

• Start the game design document

• Outline the first playable milestone

• Write clear specs for the first mechanics and levels



TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND



• A short intro about your game design experience

• Links to games, prototypes, or projects you helped design

• One example of a GDD, level design, feature spec, or gameplay breakdown
